name: canvas-as-pods
body: The window is objects on free-form pixel space. No settings tree, no privileged app chrome, no global grid. Every pod is a JSON file: close deletes it, minimize keeps it with a collapsed flag, critical is a field. Hexagon is for planning and directionality only: six neighbors, no diagonal, ring sizes 1 / 7 / 19 / 37. Panels stay rectangular. Do not restore the rails-and-ports chrome. Picture first. Not this sitting's paint job.
waitingOn: Owner Check. Picture before Fable builds.
